title: commit-if-reachable
log_line: Landing is a commit gate: incoming and reach <= tau, then bang-bang to intercept Y; else error_y. Contact, not placement. Same bars as the setpoint run. No C file. Self-play stays locked.
what: Veto on the existing 24-frame window. Steal the landing primitive as when to stop tracking and stab. Do not open a fruit-landing aim title.

rule.commit: incoming AND frames_to_paddle <= 24 AND reach <= tau
rule.on_commit: bang-bang to intercept Y (predicted_contact_y). Not desired_offset.
rule.paddle_center: paddle_y + paddleH/2. Contact body, not the top edge.

do_not: Fire when reach > tau (that reprints the 7/40 setpoint).
Lunge to desired_offset and call it landing.
Write a C hypothesis from this file.

prior.note: Setpoint was land-at-offset in the window. Geo held, scoring died. A peach does not add pixels per frame.

pass.matches_note: move-only was 12/40 vs this freeze. Need >= 13/40. Points are reported and are not a pass key.
pass.rule: All three: leak <= 0.08 AND signed_open_geo >= 0.80 AND wins >= 13. Fail any one: stop. Landing does not choose sign(offset). Geo 0.80 is a placement bar this veto is not built to clear.
